**South‑Asian countries and the (un‑translated) English titles of their national anthems**

| Country | Anthem (English‑language title, as officially used) |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Afghanistan | **“National Anthem of Afghanistan”** (officially titled *“Milli Surūd”*; the English‑language reference is simply *National Anthem of Afghanistan*) |
| Bangladesh | **“Amar Shonar Bangla”** |
| Bhutan | **“Druk Tsenden”** |
| India | **“Jana Gana Mana”** |
| Maldives | **“Gaumee Salaam”** |
| Nepal | **“Sayaun Thunga Phoolka”** |
| Pakistan | **“Pak Sarzameen Shad Baad”** (sometimes rendered simply as *National Anthem of Pakistan*) |
| Sri Lanka | **“Sri Lanka Matha”** |

These are the standard English‑language renderings of each nation’s anthem title, written in the Latin alphabet and left untranslated as requested.
